name: bespunky-voice
description: Hear Claude's questions and answer by voice, for when you're away from the screen. `/voice say` (or `/voice auto on`) speaks a listenable summary of the question; `/voice answer` records, transcribes locally, and replies for you; the `voice-conversation` skill + `ask_by_voice` MCP tool run a hands-free spoken back-and-forth. Swappable TTS (espeak-ng / say, upgradable to local Piper), local whisper.cpp STT; audio bridged by the BeSpunky devcontainer.
